info.title: Hasheous API
info.description: An API for querying game metadata

get.summary: Returns a zip file containing the metadata map dump.

404.description: If the metadata map dump is not found.

500.description: If an error occurs while generating the dump.

get.summary: Returns a zip file containing the platform specific metadata map dump.

404.description: If the metadata map dump is not found.

500.description: If an error occurs while generating the dump.

post.summary:
DEPRECATION Notice - This endpoint was used during development and should not be used anymore. It will be removed at a later date.
Look up the signature coresponding to the provided MD5 and SHA1 hash - and if available any mapped metadata ids
Look up the signature coresponding to the provided MD5 and SHA1 hash - and if available, any mapped metadata ids

parameters.name: returnAllSources
parameters.description: If true, all sources will be returned. If false, only the first source will be returned.

parameters.name: returnFields
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of fields to return in the response. If "All", all fields will be returned. Valid options are:
All, Publisher, Platform, Signatures, Metadata, Attributes

parameters.name: returnSources
parameters.description:
A comma separated list of sources to return. If null, fallback to returnAllSources. Valid options are:
TOSEC, MAMEArcade, MAMEMess, NoIntros, Redump, WHDLoad, RetroAchievements, FBNeo

requestBody.description: A JSON element with MD5 or SHA1 key value pairs representing the hashes of the ROM being queried.

200.description: Returns the game and ROM signature from available DATs, and if available mapped metadata ids.

400.description: If the provided hash is invalid.

500.description: If an error occurs while looking up the hash.

get.summary: Get a metadata bundle by its ID. Bundles contain pre-packaged metadata and images for offline use.

parameters.description: The name of the metadata source (e.g., IGDB, TheGamesDB, GiantBomb)

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the game within the specified metadata source

post.summary:
Add an archive observation to the database. An observation is a record of an archive file that has been observed - including its hashes - matching it to a specific ROM hash.
This is used to assist ROM managers in identifying and managing archive files that contain ROMs.

requestBody.description: The model containing the archive observation details

post.summary: Add a vote to a match

requestBody.description: The model to add a vote to
